newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares recover at close, focus on rates.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares recover at close, focus on rates.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Portuguese shares recovered at the close after a day marked by low volume in the absence of foreign investors. Dealers said trade tomorrow should remain focused on cement firm Cimpor, Portugal Telecom, pulp group Portucel Industrial and the banking sector. They said the market would focus on whether the Bank of Portugal would cut key rates for a second straight week on Friday. Analysts polled by Reuters said the central bank could cut rates, and the probability of a rate cut would increase if the Bank of Spain also eased monetary policy. "Volume will be concentrated on Cimpor, with attention focused on its first quarter results due to be released shortly," said one operator.
